Resolution as the entry proposes: list every held story branch in one call (git ls-remote <remote> 'refs/heads/story/*', read by exact ref name) and fetch those that moved in one fetch with several refspecs, or give the calls one shared budget inside what the opening sync and the claim leave; a story whose branch could not be read inside it is returned blocked with the reason environment, the others go on, and the next survey measures again; state this in T-BRANCH, correct the sentence of T-FRESH, and test it with five pushed stories against a remote that delays every call.
